launch_settings.command: replay of a hand-authored stream (no live run)

synthetic.label: LABELLED SYNTHETIC CHILD-RUN EXAMPLES (R1, 2026-10-24): a hand-authored stream in the Claude Code 2.1.304 stdout shape, not live evidence. One main thread spawns two Agent calls (child A, child B) in one response; each reports task_progress and task_notification usage and an Agent result. Inside child A an Agent call reuses child B's tool-use id, and its result (record 9) is reported in child A's scope. The nested call's own task records and child records are deliberately absent: how Claude Code scopes them under a reused id is not observed. Values are chosen by hand: child B's notification total equals its Agent result's totalTokens (4080) although they are different measures
purpose: two children of one parent stay separate child-run groups, never pooled or summed
a tool-use id reused under another parent is another owner's unit, in another core
the task figure and the Agent result's one-response usage are different quantities even when two values are equal
